description: Your per-event ledger. Copy this file to local/score-ledger.json inside the installed skill (install.sh never deletes local/), or keep it in career/ of your fork. Log the blind screen rank and your base-rate estimate at submission, and the result within 48h of results. After 5 events, compare forecasts with results.

simulated_panel_score.note: SELF-SCORE (not predictive) unless it ran blind

worked_example: career/score-ledger.json holds the maintainer's four events, e.g. "2026-09-buidl-ctc-fall", with post-hoc screen ranks and a calibration_log. Use them as a reference for how an entry is filled in.

how_to_add_event.step_1: Copy event_shape into events. Fill id, date, project and tracks.
how_to_add_event.step_2: At G6/G8 record simulated_panel_score (label SELF-SCORE unless blind) and screen_rank from screening-judge.md. This is the pre-commit forecast. Set verified: true only when a transcript or retro backs the entry.
how_to_add_event.step_3: Fill actual_placement + prize within 48h of results.
how_to_add_event.step_5: Add 1-3 lessons_into_skill that actually update SKILL.md / arsenal / templates.

calibration_rule: Every entry is backed by a retro or a transcript. A panel or screen run by the session that built the entry is a SELF-SCORE and never a placement forecast; record a blind screen's rank separately (screen_rank), with any LEAK the screener reported.
